command:
set -euo pipefail
R=/workspace/omega_runtime
C=$(readlink -f $R/current)
T=$R/releases/fred-reconciler-sandbox-1051
rm -rf $T
cp -a $C $T
CR=$R/carrier_repo
P=omega_deploy/093e470c5c06e3568fda535f081be7f1dcd30035-sigma-cortex-retina-v1/omega/receipt_reconciler.py
if git -C $CR cat-file -e omega-vps-deploy:$P 2>/dev/null; then REF=omega-vps-deploy; elif git -C $CR cat-file -e origin/omega-vps-deploy:$P 2>/dev/null; then REF=origin/omega-vps-deploy; else echo CARRIER_REF_MISSING; exit 21; fi
git -C $CR show $REF:$P > $T/omega/receipt_reconciler.py
python3 -m py_compile $T/omega/receipt_reconciler.py $T/omega/spool_receipt_reconciler.py
S=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf $S $T' EXIT
cp $R/data/omega_unified.db $S/omega.db
mkdir -p $S/state/outer_bridge/outbox $S/state/outer_bridge/inbox $S/state/relay_results
PYTHONPATH=$T OMEGA_RUNTIME_ROOT=$S/state OMEGA_REPO_ROOT=$T OMEGA_UNIFIED_DB=$S/omega.db OMEGA_ROUTER_CONFIG=$T/config/organ_router.json OMEGA_OUTER_SPOOL=$S/state/outer_bridge python3 -m omega.spool_receipt_reconciler --once > $S/out.json
python3 - <<PY
import hashlib,json,pathlib
t=pathlib.Path('$T')
p=t/'omega/receipt_reconciler.py'; s=(t/'omega/spool_receipt_reconciler.py')
out={'result':'PASS','base_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'spool_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'base_has_method':'def _publish_pending_results' in p.read_text(),'once_output':json.loads(pathlib.Path('$S/out.json').read_text())}
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
PY
